name: Kestrel EFB
summary: A free electronic flight bag for pilots.
description: Charts, weather, routes, approach plates, a preflight briefing and a logbook in one app. Works on Mac, Windows, iPad and iPhone, and in the browser.

name: Kestrel Drone
summary: A free airspace and preflight app for drone pilots.
description: Tap a spot to see if you can fly there, with the LAANC ceiling, TFRs and security restrictions. Drone weather with winds at 400 ft, the Kp index and twilight, plus a flight log and checklist. For recreational and Part 107 pilots.
